policy.pass_definition: Exact requested Unicode scalar and Taiwan Traditional topology agree with current CNS mapping and visible stroke structure; directly recognizable at native, exact 2x NN, 128, 64, and 32 px; ink clears the grid; no stray thorn, wrong hook, false bridge, or missing/extra semantic stroke.
policy.reject_definition: Any uncertainty, simplified/incompatible variant, missing/extra semantic component, topology-changing join, wrong turn or hook, size unreadability, grid contact, stray ink, false bridge, thorn, or unexplained small component is REJECT.
policy.raster_limit: A static raster can establish visible topology and be checked against the official CNS stroke sequence, but cannot prove the temporal act or order in which strokes were drawn.
policy.vectorization_limit: PASS permits controlled tracing of isolated image-generated dark ink only; grid lines, background variation, antialias halos, and CNS reference outlines are forbidden geometry.

authority.provider: Ministry of Digital Affairs, Taiwan, CNS11643 Chinese Standard Interchange Code Full Character Database

visual_copybook.usage: independently rasterized topology comparison only; no outline, coordinate, or trace enters the generated glyph

views: all generated cells beside independently rasterized current CNS TW-Kai topology
method.grid_detection: Five long light-gray line groups per axis were projection-detected; no equal-division or guessed fallback was accepted. Clearance is the minimum source-cell distance from L<100 ink to any cell edge bounded by detected grid-line centres.
method.stray_component_detection: L<100 pixels were grouped by 8-connectivity. No component is below 10 px. Every component below 100 px was located at native pixel coordinates and visually confirmed as an intended CNS-compatible dot stroke; exact findings are in summary.legal_small_components.
artifact_review: exact repertoire scalar, rank, cell order, and descriptor sequence
Taiwan Traditional topology and current CNS stroke structure
open counters and intentional component separation
grid contact, gray-grid contamination, and stray dark components
sharp miter, thorn-like protrusion, or false bridge at a turn
method.background_note: Near-white L>=245 standard deviation ranges from 1.25 to 1.42; background normalization remains mandatory before tracing.
